name: Exp_Donchian_Channels_System
summary: This EA trades Donchian Channel breakouts by reading signals from a custom Donchian Channels System indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward breakout and sell positions on downward breakouts, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于唐奇安通道突破策略，通过读取自定义唐奇安通道系统指标的信号进行交易。当指标发出向上突破信号时开多仓，向下突破时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的唐奇安通道突破策略，价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。入场条件由自定义指标Donchian_Channels_System的8号缓冲区决定：当Col[1]>2且Col[0]<3时触发买入信号，当Col[1]<2且Col[0]>1时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括反向信号平仓和固定止损/止盈，止损1000点、止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、固定手数。EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，并在每根新K线时重新计算交易信号，确保不会在同一根K线上重复开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements the classic Donchian Channel breakout strategy, going long when price breaks above the upper channel and short when it breaks below the lower channel. Entry conditions are determined by the custom Donchian_Channels_System indicator's buffer 8: a buy signal triggers when Col[1]>2 and Col[0]<3, while a sell signal triggers when Col[1]<2 and Col[0]>1. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals and using fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), yielding a risk-reward ratio of 2:1. Position sizing supports five money management modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, recalculating trade signals only on each new bar to prevent repeated entries on the same candle.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数（比例或手数）
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（可用保证金/余额/扣浮亏保证金/扣浮亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: Extremes
parameters.description: 极值计算方式（最高最低价/含开盘价/含收盘价等）
parameters.description_en: Extremes calculation method (High/Low, incl. Open, incl. Close, etc.)

pros: 使用经典唐奇安通道突破策略，逻辑清晰可靠，历史上被海龟交易法验证过
止损1000点、止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1，有利于长期正期望值
支持五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
新K线检测机制有效防止同一根K线重复开仓
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立开关，便于灵活控制
pros_en: Uses the classic Donchian Channel breakout strategy with clear, proven logic validated by the Turtle Trading methodology
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points provide a 2:1 risk-reward ratio, favorable for long-term positive expectancy
Supports five position sizing modes, offering flexibility for different risk preferences and account sizes
New bar detection mechanism effectively prevents duplicate entries on the same candle
Buy and sell direction open/close can be independently toggled, allowing flexible trading control
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的固定值较大，对短线交易者可能不合适且未根据市场波动自适应调整
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，只有全进全出模式，无法在趋势中逐步建仓
依赖自定义指标文件，若指标文件缺失EA将无法运行，可移植性较差
没有持仓数量限制，可能在极端行情下同时持有多个同方向仓位
信号判断逻辑中的魔术数字(1,2,3)缺乏注释说明，可读性和可维护性差
cons_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 and take profit of 2000 points are large values unsuitable for short-term traders and lack ATR-based adaptive adjustment
No position scaling logic — only all-in/all-out mode, unable to pyramid into trends gradually
Depends on a custom indicator file; if the indicator file is missing, the EA fails to initialize, reducing portability
No position count limit, potentially opening multiple same-direction positions during extreme market conditions
Signal logic uses magic numbers (1, 2, 3) without comments, resulting in poor readability and maintainability
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，使其能根据市场波动自动调整
添加持仓数量检查和最大同时持仓数限制，防止过度开仓
为指标缓冲区中的魔术数字添加详细注释，或改用命名枚举常量提高可读性
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation for automatic adaptation to market volatility
Add position count checks and maximum simultaneous position limits to prevent over-exposure
Add detailed comments for magic numbers in indicator buffer logic, or replace them with named enum constants for readability

risk_points: 固定止损止盈点数未根据市场波动率自适应，在低波动市场止损过大、高波动市场止盈过小
缺乏最大持仓数量限制和资金风险上限检查，极端行情下可能过度暴露
止损1000点对于某些品种可能过大，单笔亏损可能超出账户承受能力
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit points are not volatility-adaptive; stop may be too large in low-volatility markets and take profit too small in high-volatility markets
No maximum position count limit or capital risk ceiling check, potentially leading to over-exposure during extreme conditions
Stop loss of 1000 points may be excessively large for some instruments, causing single-trade losses beyond account tolerance
